messages.content:
I updated the project to load live reports from Supabase and removed the localStorage fallback so Live Preview will fetch and display the latest reports.

What I changed (without touching UI, scoring, or other features)
- js/app.js:
  - Disabled localStorage persistence and load (saveToStorage and loadFromStorage now no-ops/empty).
  - Initialized state.issues from demo data only as a temporary placeholder.
  - Added loadReportsFromSupabase() which fetches rows from the Supabase "reports" table, maps them to the app's issue shape, and replaces state.issues with live reports followed by demo issues.
  - Modified init() to await loading Supabase reports before rendering UI.
- I did not change js/data.js or any UI, scoring logic, or styles.

Notes and next steps
- Live Preview must have access to the internet and the Supabase client script. index.html already includes the supabase CDN and js/supabase.js which attaches window.supabaseClient — ensure Live Preview allows external scripts (some VS Code previews block remote CDN requests). If VS Code Live Preview blocks network requests to external CDNs or to Supabase, Live Preview will still show demo data only. The Live Server you're using likely allows outbound network calls, which is why it shows live reports.
- If Live Preview still shows only demo reports, check DevTools Console in Live Preview for errors:
  - Missing or blocked js/supabase.js or CDN (CSP or offline).
  - CORS or network errors contacting the Supabase endpoint.
  - Supabase anon key restrictions or row-level security (RLS). If RLS is enabled on the reports table, make sure anonymous select is allowed or configure the policy.

If you want, I can:
- Add console logging or a small diagnostic banner showing "Live reports loaded: N" vs "Demo-only" so you can see easily which data source is active.
- Adjust the Supabase select query (e.g., select specific columns or a different ordering).
- Help you debug Live Preview networking: paste the Live Preview console errors and I'll suggest fixes.

Which would you like next?

Add Hindi and English multilingual support to CivicPulse without changing the existing UI. Add a language selector and allow citizens to submit and view reports in both languages. Hindi text must be properly stored and displayed through Supabase. Connect the selected language with the voice feature so English uses en-IN and Hindi uses hi-IN speech recognition. Keep all existing features working.
